{{Conjecture|legends}}
A [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] '''attack''' was carried out by the [[Duroon Rebels]] against [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] officials at a promotional screening of ''[[Who Are You To Accuse Me?]]'' in [[Mondder]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. An [[Unidentified Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media|individual]] serving as [[Assistant Advisory Undersecretary of Media]] was saved from [[Death/Legends|death]] by the [[Tiss'shar/Legends|Tiss'shar]] [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslinger]] [[Uul-Rha-Shan]] who was working as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for a minor [[Unidentified Millennium Entertainments official|official]] of [[Millennium Entertainments]].
